title: Photon from a hydrogen line
statement:
For the hydrogen transition $n=[$n]\to2$, calculate the wavelength in nm. Use $E_n=-(2.179\times10^{-18}\ \mathrm J)/n^2$, $h=6.626\times10^{-34}$ J·s, $c=2.998\times10^8$ m/s.

[________]{a}

feedback.message: Convert the final meters to nanometers.

hints: Convert the final meters to nanometers.
solution: Use positive gap $A(1/4-1/[$n]^2)$ in $\lambda=hc/E$, then multiply meters by $10^9$ for nm.
